## Functions

### saveTo

**Function** - [src/store-persist.ts:74](https://github.com/lucianofedericopereira/vapor-chamber/blob/main/src/store-persist.ts#L74)

```ts
saveTo<S>(options: SaveToOptions<S>) => StorePersist<S>
```

saveTo - a store's saved state, the value of its `persist` option: read when
the store is created, saved once per microtask after any of its writes,
whatever wrote it. An async storage is read when it answers; the writes made
before then are replayed on the saved state by the undo ring's rule (a
reducer runs again, a state set whatever came before is kept), and nothing is
saved before it lands. A missing `key` throws here.

```ts
defineChamberStore('cart', { state, reducers, persist: saveTo({ key: 'vc:cart' }) });
```

### shareTabs

**Function** - [src/store-share.ts:98](https://github.com/lucianofedericopereira/vapor-chamber/blob/main/src/store-share.ts#L98)

```ts
shareTabs<S>(name?: string) => StoreShare<S>
```

shareTabs - propagate a store across the tabs of one origin, the value of
its `share` option: one `BroadcastChannel` and one Web Lock per store, both
named `vc:store:<id>` unless `name` is given. The tab holding the lock runs
every tab's command and posts it on, and the others follow it. A tab that
opens asks for the state and takes the lead's answer. Outside a page or a
worker (a server), without `BroadcastChannel` or without Web Locks, nothing
opens: without the lock, tabs could end on two states, so development warns.

```ts
defineChamberStore('cart', { state, reducers, share: shareTabs() });
```

## Type aliases

### ChamberStore

**Type alias** - [src/store-base.ts:140](https://github.com/lucianofedericopereira/vapor-chamber/blob/main/src/store-base.ts#L140)

```ts
export type ChamberStore<S extends object, R extends Record<string, StoreReducer<S> | null>, B extends BaseBus = BaseBus> = {
  readonly $id: string;
  /** Read-only by construction: there is no setter, so a direct write throws in
   *  strict mode. The bus is the only mutation channel. */
  readonly state: { readonly value: S };
  /** URL-backed fields (4B), absent when no `url` map was declared. */
  readonly url: Record<string, { readonly value: string | undefined; set: (next: unknown) => void }>;
  /** Dispatches `<id>$reset`, which sets `state()` afresh: a command like any
   *  action, so plugins, listeners and history see it. Returns the dispatch
   *  result, on an async bus its promise. */
  $reset: () => ResultOn<B>;
  /** Call `fn` with a field's new value each time a write changes it (by
   *  identity), the store's own keyed event; returns the unsubscribe. A store
   *  with no subscriber writes as it would without. docs/store.md. */
  $onField: <K extends keyof S & string>(key: K, fn: (value: S[K]) => void) => () => void;
  /** Resolves once the store holds the state it starts from: its saved state
   *  read (`persist` on an async storage), its tabs' state taken (`share`), or
   *  both. At once for a store with neither. Never waits on a field event, and
   *  a failed read or a store disposed early resolves too.
   *  tests/store-ready.test.ts. */
  readonly $ready: Promise<void>;
  $dispose: () => void;
} & { [K in keyof R]: (target?: any, payload?: any) => ResultOn<B> };
```

A store on bus `B`: its actions and `$reset` return what `B`'s dispatch
returns (`ResultOn`). tests/store-result-types.test.ts.

### PersistStorage

**Type alias** - [src/store-persist.ts:21](https://github.com/lucianofedericopereira/vapor-chamber/blob/main/src/store-persist.ts#L21)

```ts
export type PersistStorage = {
  getItem(key: string): string | null | Promise<string | null>;
  setItem(key: string, value: string): void | Promise<void>;
};
```

What a store's `persist` reads and writes: `localStorage`'s two methods. Each
may answer a promise, as `indexedDbStorage()` does: the store then reads the
saved state when it lands, and a rejection warns as a throw does.

### SaveToOptions

**Type alias** - [src/store-persist.ts:27](https://github.com/lucianofedericopereira/vapor-chamber/blob/main/src/store-persist.ts#L27)

```ts
export type SaveToOptions<S> = {
  /** Storage key. Use a unique prefix per feature: `'vc:cart'`. */
  key: string;
  /** Default: `globalThis.localStorage`, looked up at each read and save. `indexedDbStorage()` for IndexedDB. */
  storage?: PersistStorage;
  /** Default: `JSON.stringify`. */
  serialize?: (state: S) => string;
  /** Default: `JSON.parse`, a parse failure read as nothing saved. Return null to start from `state()`. */
  deserialize?: (raw: string) => S | null;
  /** Accept a read state, or false to start from `state()` with a warning: a check of its shape. */
  validate?: (state: S) => boolean;
};
```

What `saveTo` takes.
